description: addon-ssl + pg_client_cert=true, exercised as the cert-only target for passwordless per-role-CN clients (gitea/zitadel). Same server side as postgres/mtls (managed pg_hba.conf cert-only, ssl_ca_file=/certs/chain.pem, local trust preserved); check-pg-mtls asserts password-only TCP is rejected. Consumers (gitea/mtls, zitadel/mtls-certonly) create their no-password LOGIN roles via TEST-ONLY livetest-local overlays and authenticate purely by client-cert CN == role; production proxvex creates no DB role SQL (operator's job).
